hints: Compare the depth of the leftmost and rightmost paths: equal depths mean the subtree is perfect, holding 2^h - 1 nodes.
When the depths differ, the last level is partial, so count the root plus both sides recursively.
Each recursion descends only one side fully, giving O(log^2 n) time.
